name: Default
shortDescription: Web-based CMDB and IT service management tool for assets, incidents, changes and service catalogs, with MariaDB and a background cron worker.

alerts.message: Open the site right after deploying to run the setup wizard: until it is completed, anyone who reaches the site can run it. On the database step use server itop-db, login itop and the generated DB_PASSWORD, then select the existing itop database. Create the administrator account with ITOP_ADMIN_USER and ITOP_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment: the cron service signs in with them to run notifications, SLAs and backups.
